result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. Although subsection (a) grants Licensee an affiliate/successor assignment right and removes Licensor’s change-of-control termination right, subsection (c) still prohibits every Licensee assignment without Licensor consent, creating a direct conflict. The retained sentence regarding when Licensor may reasonably withhold change-of-control consent is also inapplicable and internally inconsistent with the revised preceding sentence. In addition, the clause imposes no restriction on Licensor assignments, including assignments to a Licensee competitor, as required by the preferred position, and it does not establish the fallback mutual successor-assignment framework. The added rights against suspension and repricing and permission to assign 'in part' go beyond the stated rule without resolving the necessary assignment-clause changes. The margin comment correctly identifies the issue, but the operative language fails to implement it.
